title: UniMoMo: Expert Merging-Based MoE Acceleration for Large Recommendation Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.08627v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) layers expand recommendation capacity through conditional computation, yet a trained checkpoint still stores and routes over its full expert bank. We study a deployment problem: convert that checkpoint to a smaller standard MoE under an explicit expert budget, without adding a compression-specific online module. To address this, we introduce UniMoMo, a post-training compression framework formulated as a constrained graph coarsening problem. Rather than relying on parameter distance, UniMoMo groups experts based on their functional similarity, using an unlabeled calibration set to measure how similarly experts respond to shared recommendation states. To prevent performance degradation, we introduce a layer-adaptive protection mechanism that restricts the merging of high-traffic experts based on their routing exposure. translated_title: UniMoMo：基于专家合并的MoE加速方法，用于大型推荐模型
translated_abstract: 稀疏混合专家层通过条件计算扩展了推荐系统的容量，然而一个已训练的模型检查点仍然需要存储完整的专家库并对其全量路由。我们研究了一个部署问题：在明确的专家预算约束下，将该检查点转换为更小的标准MoE，且无需添加任何针对压缩的在线模块。为此，我们提出了UniMoMo，一个被形式化为约束图粗化问题的训练后压缩框架。UniMoMo不依赖参数距离，而是基于专家的功能相似性对专家进行分组，利用无标签校准集来衡量各专家对共享推荐状态的响应相似程度。为防止性能下降，我们引入了一种层自适应保护机制，根据路由暴露度限制高流量专家的合并。在Amazon Beauty、KuaiRec和TenRec数据集上，针对包含2、4和6个MoE块的模型，最终的四（摘要原文在此处被截断）……
tldr: UniMoMo提出了一种训练后压缩框架，通过基于功能相似性的约束图粗化来合并MoE专家，并结合层自适应保护机制限制高流量专家合并，从而在给定专家预算下加速大型推荐模型而不损失性能。
en_tdlr: UniMoMo is a post-training compression framework that merges MoE experts based on functional similarity via constrained graph coarsening, with a layer-adaptive protection mechanism restricting the merging of high-traffic experts, thereby accelerating large recommendation models under an explicit expert budget without performance degradation.
